calls.title: Ashley Stirrup and Matthew Hunt
calls.summary: The discussion emphasized enhancing LinkedIn advertising efficacy by recommending a minimum budget of $100 per thought leadership post for better retargeting impact, while refining audience segmentation to combine ABM data and job titles for precision. Additionally, simplifying conversion tracking to focus on demo-related actions was stressed to ensure clearer ROI insights. Matthew proposed a substantial increase in monthly ad spend to $30,000 to maximize pipeline influence and further integrate events into the marketing strategy. Emphasis was also placed on executing tailored pre- and post-event campaigns for eight planned events within the year and adapting content strategy to include thought leadership messaging segmented by buyer roles, all aimed at improving engagement.
calls.keywords: LinkedIn Ads, Retargeting, ABM, Thought Leadership, Pipeline Attribution, Event Marketing
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Review and reactivate archived retargeting lists in LinkedIn Campaign Manager and ensure they are properly utilized to improve campaign effectiveness (07:53)
Adjust conversion tracking setup to eliminate non-demo page views and focus strictly on demo-related conversions to improve measurement accuracy (11:35)
Implement at least a $100 budget boost behind every thought leadership LinkedIn post targeting the refined retargeting audience to increase engagement and pipeline impact (03:57)
Collaborate with media/contact team to segment target audiences by job function and seniority and develop tailored creative messaging to improve engagement and conversion rates (35:00)
Create and test hyper-targeted company-specific ad creatives for named accounts (e.g., Robinhood, Dropbox) to increase relevance and response rates (41:44)
Coordinate multi-phase event marketing campaigns with pre-event outreach, attendance engagement, and post-event follow-up ads and offers to maximize offline meetings and deal acceleration (24:30)
Communicate with Graham's team and Dave to better integrate content generation with sponsored advertising spend and strategy for cohesive marketing efforts (45:08)

**Matthew Hunt**
Provide Ashley with meeting notes and best practices summary to support communication with current LinkedIn advertising resource and enhance campaign management (28:00)
Continue training and onboarding Biz, the new paid media strategist, to support enhanced LinkedIn paid media efforts and campaign optimization (46:40)
Offer ongoing strategic consulting at $1,500 per engagement to support campaign optimization and budget ramping as company readiness allows (49:45)
